sources.items: George, Leela, Mike, Stan: rig/limb articulation donors only; reject unchanged silhouettes and social/dance clips for GRAVIVORE combat.
sources.why: Four visibly distinct bipedal robots; 2368–7864 tris, 17–47 bones. Useful mechanical joints, no approved enemy-role match. G-0 replacement explicitly excluded.

sources.items: CircleImpact, CrossShoot, Muzzle and selected smoke/impact flipbooks: donor textures; reject blood/cartoon bursts and source preview scripts.
sources.why: 18 prefabs with large 1536–3072 textures and multiple particle layers. Reuse a few masks in existing pooled URP effects; stock animation was not runtime reviewed.

sources.items: Floor/Tile/WallMetal, door-frame and Crate_01 families: USE after shared material conversion; bundled HDRP/URP archives are duplicate variants; source script excluded.
sources.why: 125 canonical FBX, generally inexpensive geometric panel detail. Selected crate/panel surfaces read clearly from above. Supports floor/wall variation, not a complete damaged industrial scene.

sources.items: Generator_v1, Oil_tank_v1, Cargo_container_v1, Industrial_pipe/Pipes_set: shell/cover donors; reject roads, grass, skyboxes and real-world hangar dressing.
sources.why: 36 FBX, 8–5046 tris. Useful industrial massing but weaker sci-fi identity; 4K source maps and uncertain prefab material reproduction require selective rebuild.

sources.items: Laser_tower, Turret_v1 and Structure_v1/v2/v3: emitter/support donors; reject unchanged vehicles and strategy-building proportions.
sources.why: Actual local free v1, not paid v3. Nine FBX, up to 9414 tris. Distinct barrel/support mechanisms can supplement M-0, no equipment progression family ready.

sources.items: Normal Assets buttons, dividers, selected/unselected inventory slots: USE; reject upscaled duplicates. Fonts remain excluded until separate OFL notices are packaged.
sources.why: Catherine Laserna CC BY 4.0 established locally. Thin sci-fi frames support a consistent portrait HUD skin. Native PNGs still need authored slicing, atlas and readable health/boss/minimap composition.

sources.items: Assembled tower hierarchy and barrel/head supports: DONOR; unchanged static turret is not the player weapon.
sources.why: One 5784-triangle FBX, one material. Strong top-down muzzle source silhouette; equipment mount, pivot and cyan player identity need adaptation.

sources.items: Four fog-color prefabs/masks: ambient donor; reject lava/snow bonus visuals for Chapter01.
sources.why: Single-system layers with serialized cap 1000 each. Needs low particle cap, localized volume, depth ordering and overdraw validation; no fair static animation evidence.

sources.items: 76 magic prefabs and optional bloom/light presentation rejected as a stock family.
sources.why: Many layered effects, some 6–11 systems with caps of 1000 per system. Wrong magical motif and higher adaptation/overdraw cost than existing industrial pooled effects.

sources.items: Generator, lattice, container and explicit LOD1 exports: reserve geometry donors; reject whole brightly stylized modular room family.
sources.why: 202 FBX including LOD variants, 12–1720 tris. Cheap support geometry but material/normal import requires review and style overlaps the chosen backbone.

sources.items: Complete modular space family rejected for visible Chapter01 integration.
sources.why: Very simple/toy-like silhouettes and palette do not close the dense damaged-metal gap. Some shapes reach 10880 tris despite simple appearance; duplicates chosen kit coverage.

sources.items: Complete station family rejected for visible integration; no additional source mixing for generic boxes.
sources.why: 97 FBX, 12–272 tris: excellent geometry cost but too clean and sparse for the concept. Readability alone does not justify a second conflicting environment style.

sources.items: Small glyphs, bars, panel/button borders: DONOR to EXE-based skin; reject wholesale mixed-color HUD and duplicate states.
sources.why: Included CC0 license confirms UI Pack Sci-fi 2.0. 742 PNG files are variants/sheets, not 742 unique UI components. Strong low-cost fallback for missing utility shapes.

sources.items: AR_1, AR_4, Sniper_1, Pistol_1 plus Body/Barrel/Scope/Stock parts: donor family; reject unchanged humanoid gun grips on G-0.
sources.why: 78 FBX, 200–4898 tris. Best coherent CC0 modular progression base, but M-0 emitter housing and mech socket/silhouette remain custom.

sources.items: Platform_Metal/DarkPlates/Rails/Ramp/Stairs, ShortWall_MetalPlates, Door_Frame/DarkMetal, TopCables_Straight, Column_Pipes, Prop_Vent and Prop_Light: USE selected families; reject unnecessary room furniture/decor duplication.
sources.why: 189 canonical models in downloaded free Standard subset, not the full advertised kit. Modular layered forms give the clearest coherent floor/service backbone. Palette must be unified to cold worn metal with restrained energy colors.

sources.items: Generator, Generator Pile, Cryo Tube, Centrifuge, Command, Container and Floor Metal Square Grate families: USE for machinery/support detail; reject generic furniture and plant dressing.
sources.why: 136 FBX, 34–4132 tris and up to three materials. Useful vertical industrial massing at low geometry cost. Gradient atlas is stylized color, not a PBR wear set; shared material adaptation required.

sources.items: MediumMechStriker articulation/shoulder and weapon mechanisms: DONOR; reject unchanged blue stock mech and fragments as enemies/G-0 replacement.
sources.why: Actual MSGDI Asset Store v1.1 id124342, superseding V1 Sketchfab/CC BY assumption. Main model 6472 tris, 17 bones; 4K maps and private source-handling cost. Five bundled RAR formats not imported.

sources.items: Rune chamber/seed props, VFX graphs and stock scene rejected.
sources.why: 84 FBX, peak 142636 tris, 4K maps, graph dependencies. Fantasy/rune motifs and several costly models do not improve the industrial concept efficiently.

sources.items: EyeDrone, QuadShell, Trilobite: enemy-shell/rig donors. Prop_Crate/Barrel/Locker: selected cover donors. No approved Scout/Cutter/elite silhouette is ready unchanged.
sources.why: 37 canonical FBX, three materially distinct rigged enemies. EyeDrone3530/QuadShell7494/Trilobite8338 tris; 8/28/20 bones. Detailed crate surfaces useful, but white/yellow stock palette and foot topology need role-specific redesign.

sources.items: FloorTile01/02, WallBayDoor, WallFan, Pipes01/02, DuctVent: donor surfaces/services; scripts excluded; do not import binary prefabs wholesale.
sources.why: 83 FBX, 12–3112 tris with up to six materials. Strong industrial vocabulary; binary source prefabs and incomplete embedded material reconstruction make it a geometry/surface donor, not an unchanged USE family.

sources.items: Stock VFX Graph black hole, bloom volume and custom Shader Graphs rejected.
sources.why: Requires graph pipeline dependencies beyond baseline and includes 6144px imagery. No need to add a package for one effect; continue current pooled source/travel/impact language.

sources.items: TechPipes_Scene 20-piece assembly retained locally; no production use until exact attribution license is confirmed and assembly split/optimized.
sources.why: One 95364-triangle FBX, three materials, 2048 maps; conflicting duplicate texture members safely preserved. Indexed publisher CC Attribution signal does not establish exact license version; no included license.

sources.items: Publisher-authored frames potentially reusable later; Icons8 icons excluded. Whole mixed-rights pack cannot be USE.
sources.why: Five PNG/two PSD source files. Creator says free commercial use for own graphics, but icons have a separate license and full redistribution/attribution terms are unresolved. EXE already covers the primary frame role.

sources.items: Fourteen turret/laser FBX family rejected for visible integration.
sources.why: 502–8566 tris, small 256px maps and dated block silhouettes. Duplicates RTS/tower donors without enough distinct visual gain.

sources.items: A few fire/smoke flipbook textures: donor to small pooled industrial vents/impacts; source shader/light/audio prefab setup rejected unchanged.
sources.why: 18 prefabs, 32 TGA up to2048, five custom shaders; layered systems with caps1000. Shader and overdraw adaptation not runtime validated.

sources.items: Drone angular shell and side fins: Arc Drone donor; reject stock yellow/black identity and direct enemy-prefab replacement.
sources.why: 1362 tris, one material, no rig. Strong elevated-view angular body, but approved hostile core/readability and attack anchors need custom work.
